address_space_checkpoint.status: Native RM-owned address-space integration complete; 0.79.11 T2/T4 remain open for buffer mappings/channels
address_space_checkpoint.scope: Actual RM graph allocates a new private FERMI_VASPACE_A child, returns validated live metadata after ACK and frees it in reverse graph teardown.

semantics.request: GSP_ALLOC103, class90f1, raw48-byte parameters, indexNEW, flags0, default base/size, explicit64K big pages.
semantics.response: Full80-byte success required. Pinned constructor returns base and byte length; reject zero/overflow/unaligned/over49-bit ranges and changed input flags.
semantics.management: Page tables belong to RM. No externally supplied PDB, ATS, shared management, app address or buffer mapping.
semantics.names: Seven initial child names reserved atomically; existing six IDs stable, VASpace uses slot6. Event aliases rejected.
semantics.queue: One actual GSP exchange/token and unchanged admission/deadline rules; notifications use existing runtime dispatch.
semantics.rejection: ACKed RM allocation rejection preserves display/receiver inventory with no native address-space capability.
semantics.failure: Malformed success, timeout and failed ACK retain names/backing; logical stop hides the address-space view.
semantics.free: Events then VASpace then I2C then base objects. Free rejection retains VASpace/parents; acknowledged object free is not global GPU quiescence.
